inferred_choices_and_limits: Host datasets are empty and scalar policy/entitlement/camera flags initially false; warning sound kits and nameplate dimensions initially zero. No native defaults, acquisition, persistence or 3D camera projection are claimed.
Action range inputs are spell/GUID-keyed; absent data yields nil even for unranged actions. Direct pet-spell assignments share pet action autocast flags; macros/items/outfits are not resolved.

Battle.net success is local acceptance/outbound intent, not delivery. Existing limits/routing are reused; whispers require a known online account and <=4078 bytes, and chat lockdown rejects whispers/broadcast mutation. Local custom message is stored but legacy BNGetInfo remains a temporary account probe.
Warning enablement is host availability AND encounterWarningsEnabled; encounter release/resurrection/timeline flags are independent host snapshots, not inferred from encounter-in-progress.

Training catalog display order and metadata are host inputs. JoinTrainingGround identifies LFG dungeon IDs as cached PVPUI does, rejects unavailable/unknown/non-enterable requests and uses one existing battlefield queue slot. Completed-match and daily-win flags require host updates.
Recipe quality links error on unconfigured tuples, rather than fabricate links. Item quality records are nullable fresh snapshots; no DB2 quality/reagent catalog is acquired.
Prey selection requires membership in the existing rich quest log; widget progress/effects are host snapshots, not a progression/timer engine or widget-set population service.
Weekly completions are separate from vault threshold rows, sorted descending difficulty. Combining difficulties sums points and chooses lowest activityTierID; ties use ascending ID.

Outfit tooltip is a bounded title-only payload from existing catalog name/identity (type 27), not native appearance descriptions/layout. Publication is gated with the existing 12.0.5 outfit model; strict historical builds were not exercised.

Spell classifications use existing number/name spell lookup, without alias overrides. Important IDs share aura_filter_facts; other booleans use explicit classifications. Pinned VM rejects tainted secret identifiers; AllowedWhenTainted parity remains unsupported.

LimitedInputAllowed reads four persistent host grants; it does not consume grants or change mouse-event dispatch. Combat-log restriction is a host query flag, not enforcement of native log filtering/secrecy. Bonus stable slot is independent of the existing stable-open flag.
Catalog new-product IDs preserve host order and are independent of ownership; no checkout/refund/confirmation service is supplied.

IsItemBindToAccount reads existing bonding metadata (ItemBind 7/8/9); including until-equipped mode 9 in the generic predicate is INFERRED. It classifies intrinsic metadata, not instance ownership/bound state.
manual_review: Main-thread source review only (delegation explicitly forbidden): real registrations/state wiring, fresh/rooted DTOs, selectors and borrow lifetimes, epoch gates; no new warning suppression, vendor edits, monkey patches, alternate resolvers or source-substring tests. DTO emitters retain flat field lists; native parity limits remain explicit.
